    Diagonal coefficients of products of string graph-component maps #

    This file reduces a possible nonzero diagonal coefficient of a component-map product to a full-support oriented self-interval. The midpoint argument excluding a proper full-support interval is developed below.

      False

      A proper self-component cannot be a full reversal of the word-position interval. At an even midpoint it would meet the diagonal; at an odd midpoint it would match one word edge with the same edge traversed in the opposite direction.
